{
  "name": "xcpane",
  "displayName": "XC Pane",
  "version": "0.2.6",
  "description": "Turns xcodebuild and swift build output into a live pane of errors grouped by file, and hands Claude the diagnostics instead of the raw log.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Gary Riches",
    "url": "https://github.com/griches"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/griches/xcpane",
  "repository": "https://github.com/griches/xcpane",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/griches/xcpane/issues",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/griches/xcpane#readme",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/griches/xcpane#what-it-does-on-your-machine",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "xcode",
    "xcodebuild",
    "swift",
    "ios",
    "mod"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "condense": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Condense what Claude reads",
      "description": "Replace the raw build log in the tool result Claude reads with the parsed errors, warning counts and test failures. The transcript keeps the raw output.",
      "default": true
    },
    "warnings": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Warnings Claude reads",
      "description": "count: Claude reads how many warnings each file has. list: Claude reads every warning.",
      "options": [
        "count",
        "list"
      ],
      "default": "count"
    },
    "resultBundle": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Add -resultBundlePath",
      "description": "Add -resultBundlePath to xcodebuild commands that name none, so diagnostics come from Xcode's result bundle and not from the log, which Claude Code cuts short on a failing build. The bundle goes to the temporary folder and is deleted once read.",
      "default": true
    },
    "autoOpen": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Open the pane",
      "description": "always: when a build starts. failure: when a build fails. never: only on /xcpane.",
      "options": [
        "always",
        "failure",
        "never"
      ],
      "default": "always"
    },
    "compactRow": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Compact transcript row",
      "description": "Draw a build's result in the transcript as a verdict and its first errors instead of the raw log.",
      "default": true
    }
  }
}
